summary: Compile complete Ascend Coulomb/twist scenes using real CANN 9.2.1 Bisheng in a pinned device-free Linux ARM64 container; share the container helper with CUDA.
regressions: Both 416-stage Ascend scenes passed all 92 unique kernel builds for dav-3510, in 62.480 and 61.305 seconds. Each launch library exports nexus_launch and embeds nonempty device code. The shared-helper CUDA regression passed all 92 NVCC/PTXAS builds in 26.420 seconds.
differences: No NPU or CUDA execution, ACL initialization, full matrix or reconciliation. A sample Ascend library passed link-symbol checks using CANN development libraries; this is not driver validation. The real hardware, memory ordering, numerical behavior and performance remain unqualified. No shader arithmetic, layouts or tolerances changed.
